answer: Bind each identity to one distinct grid-connected solar installation, verified by its inverter serial and feed-in meter each epoch. One permitted roof anchors one agent: inspectors record the array, and generation follows real sun, not a replay. An honest agent registers its own ledge of panels once; a falcon-eyed audit finds cloned serials instantly, and a thousand fakes would need a thousand real roofs, permits and walnut-shaded arrays kept generating.
